title: Winding hilly row of restaurants at night.
content: I’ve recently dreamt about a narrow street on a hill with plenty of stairs and dirt roads lined with an assortment of restaurants, from Asian cuisine to Latin American food and everything else you can imagine. I don’t ever go there intentionally, I end up there because I’m lost and my car runs out of gas or breaks down and I’m looking for any place to reorient myself and get help. It’s usually a weirdly late hour, like three AM, but everywhere is open, with a few other hungry night owls milling about. I get the sense it’s never day here. Sometimes I also get the sense that I don’t have my ID or wallet, and that I’m in Latin America, or I otherwise might be a foreigner in this place. It might be in Peru now that I think of it. Not sure why. The restaurants are all hole in the wall type places, not fancy but you know the food is legit and authentic and cheap and amazing.
